text:
ravi: quick heads-up — Beta partner HealthSynth wants an Optimize "autosuggester" pilot: console-visible batching + cache recommendations and eval-triggered alerts. target: clinical extraction pipeline, goal start in ~6 weeks.

claire: 6 weeks is aggressive but doable if we cut scope. propose MLP = (A) deterministic heuristics for batching by token-length, (B) cache toggles (prefix TTL + KV on/off) with telemetry, (C) eval-alerts surfaced read-only in Console (no auto mitigation). postpone quantization and ML controllers to phase 2.

tony: agree. we'll need clear acceptance criteria from HealthSynth: latency SLOs (p95/p99) and which quality metric to monitor (e.g., summary-F1). also ask for a labeled eval set (1k preferred) or permission to run sentinel probes.

ravi: they asked for p95 < 300ms for short extracts. tolerance is 3% absolute drop on our summary-F1 before human review. they can supply ~600 labeled examples now.

claire: Ops constraints: pilot will run on Dedicated with mixed GPUs. batching must not push p99 beyond 650ms. need per-route dashboards: batch-size histogram, cache hit rate, token-savings, and eval-alert counts.

ravi: implementation sketch — length buckets + per-bucket static max + latency cap that drains batching when tail approaches budget. fallback to sync path on timeouts. sample config we can expose in Console: 

```json
{"optimize.batching.enabled":"true","optimize.batching.buckets":"[48,256,1024]","optimize.batching.max_by_bucket":"[14,8,3]","optimize.batching.latency_cap_ms":"300","optimize.cache.prefix_ttl_s":"40","optimize.cache.kv_mode":"light"}
```

ton y: for eval-alerts: integrate existing eval infra. signals = sentinel probe failure rate, embedding distribution drift, and ROUGE/F1 regression on sample set. compute a composite score; alert when composite > threshold for N consecutive windows (window size = 500 requests). show per-signal breakdown in alert.

infra-bot: quick check -> we can tag metrics ingestion with `optimize_v1` but need an infra change ticket. creating INF-5488. ETA ~3d.

infra-bot: ticket INF-5488 opened for metrics tag.

sophie: negotiation note: Product asks 6 weeks but engineering alignment shows 8 weeks if we include full instrumentation, onboarding, and customer eval collection. Can we split deliverables?

claire: yes. propose Phase A (6 weeks): heuristic batching + cache toggles + read-only eval alerts + console telemetry. Phase B (4 weeks after pilot): UI recommendations, exportable config, ML controller and quant recs.

ravi: Action items for initial kickoff: 1) we ask HealthSynth for traffic_profile.csv and the labeled eval set (or approval to run sentinel probes); 2) infra -> INF-5488 ETA and reserve Dedicated slice; 3) eng -> branch PR for heuristic batching + fallback; 4) product -> Console copy for why recommendations and quick token-savings estimate.

tony: risks: small eval set -> noisy alerts; customer traffic not representative; and delaying quant recs might disappoint. mitigations: require human ack for alerts, add a cool-down/confirm step, and set pilot expectation doc.

ops-bot: runbook stub created: RUN-2201. steps: acknowledge alert -> run evaluation job -> compare to baseline -> assign to model-owner -> consider toggling batching conservatively.

sophie: acceptance gates for Phase A: (1) heuristic batching live and p95/p99 visible in Console, (2) cache toggles operate and token-savings tracked, (3) eval-alerts surface with signal taxonomy + links to eval job, (4) HealthSynth signs off on threshold mapping.

ravi: I'll draft the pilot acceptance doc and schedule kickoff. if HealthSynth can't provide 1k labels we'll run expanded sentinel probes but flag higher false-positive risk. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
